name: TC-917: 3DS failed through a full-page redirect — back on checkout with the error, nothing charged
description: FAIL on Stripe's hosted 3DS page → Stripe sends the browser to /checkout/return with the same parameters; the intent is now requires_payment_method. The return page sends the customer back to /checkout with the payment error shown and the cart intact; no confirm-payment; same backend checks as TC-915.

steps.name: Add the item through the menu and open checkout
Click getByTestId('menu-item-card').filter({ hasText: 'Automation Burger' }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'Automation Burger', exact: true })).first()
Stripe sends the whole page to its hosted 3DS page
the confirm asked for a redirect
Stripe returned to /checkout/return for this PaymentIntent
Checkout says the payment didn't go through
Expect "toBeVisible" getByText(/unable to authenticate|failed authentication|payment was not completed|bank didn't approve this payment/i).first()
no confirm-payment for a failed check
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Complete Order' }).or(getByRole('button', { name: 'Proceed to Payment' }))
Backend: not paid, nothing charged, no order for the owner
